headline: Recommended final passage of $9,000,000 bonds for city ERP system and $5,173,428 for capital equipment, plus fire station and library bonds.
summary: Motions to recommend final passage were made on eight bond resolutions, and each motion carried. The bonds cover capital equipment, a library renovation, a fire training facility, a replacement Pine Hill fire station, fire station maintenance, and a citywide ERP system.
decisions: Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $5,173,428 for the purchase of capital equipment; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $3,000,000 for design and ancillary costs to renovate the Nashua Public Library; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $1,500,000 for the design, construction and equipping of a fire training facility; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for the design and other ancillary costs to replace the Pine Hill Fire Station; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for deferred capital maintenance of fire stations; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $9,000,000 for the replacement and modernization of the city-wide ERP system; motion carried.
